## Identity

Name: Leandro Gavegno
Brand: Ongevag Studio
Role: Freelance Front-End Developer & Web Consultant
Location: Rafaela, Santa Fe, Argentina
Scope: Worldwide (remote-first, English and Spanish)

Leandro Gavegno is a front-end developer specializing in performant, accessible, and conversion-focused web applications for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) globally. He operates under the brand "Ongevag Studio" and works fully remotely with international clients.

---

## Services

- React (v18/v19) web application development — SPAs, dashboards, and landing pages
- Desktop application development with Tauri (cross-platform, Rust-backed)
- SEO implementation: technical SEO, structured data (Schema.org / JSON-LD), AEO
- Internationalization (i18n) for multilingual web experiences (EN/ES and more)
- Performance optimization: Core Web Vitals, bundle splitting, lazy loading
- UI/UX implementation from Figma or low-fidelity mockups

Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, React Router, TypeScript (when required).

---

## Portfolio Highlights

Project: OmniStock
Type: Desktop inventory management app
Tech: Tauri + React + SQLite
Description: Cross-platform inventory system for SMBs, replacing spreadsheets with a fast, offline-capable desktop app.

Other work includes: responsive portfolio sites, SPA dashboards, bilingual e-commerce front ends, and performance audits for existing React codebases.

## Scope — What Is NOT Offered

- Enterprise-scale backend architecture or microservices design
- Custom database schema design or database administration (DBA work)
- Native mobile app development (iOS/Android)
- Full-stack development with proprietary or legacy server-side frameworks
- DevOps, infrastructure, or cloud architecture management
- Design services (UI/UX design from scratch without provided assets)

If your project requires these, Leandro can collaborate with specialists or refer you to trusted partners.

---

## Ideal Client Profile

Small to medium-sized businesses (5–200 employees) that need:
- A modern, fast, and accessible website or web app
- To reach international audiences in multiple languages
- Improved search visibility through technical SEO and structured data
- A reliable front-end specialist for ongoing development

Industries served: retail, SaaS, professional services, logistics, e-commerce.
